context: The mother deliberates over which puppy to choose
purpose: Decide on a puppy; teach 匹/だめ/我慢/ワン/もつ/在庫/とれ/垢

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 何匹か見て、迷っちゃいます。
lines.en: Seeing several of them, I cannot decide.
lines.style: torn mother weighing a big family choice

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ゆっくり選び。焦ったらだめやで。
lines.en: Take your time. Rushing is no good.
lines.style: patient Kansai owner easing her pressure

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 子どもが我慢できるか心配で。
lines.en: I worry whether my child can be patient.
lines.style: anxious mother thinking about her son

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 最初は我慢の練習や。世話は大変やからな。
lines.en: At first it is patience training. Care is hard work.
lines.style: honest owner setting realistic expectations gently

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ワンちゃんの名前、もう決めたみたい。
lines.en: It seems he already picked the puppy’s name.
lines.style: amused mother sharing a fond detail

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええな。呼んだらすぐ来るよう、しつけよ。
lines.en: Nice. Train it to come when called.
lines.style: encouraging Kansai owner offering practical advice

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: フード、どれくらいもつものですか？
lines.en: How long does the food last?
lines.style: careful mother checking the running costs

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 一袋で十日はもつで。在庫も切らさんよう置いとく。
lines.en: A bag lasts ten days. I keep it stocked.
lines.style: dependable owner reassuring about supply, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 首輪がとれないか心配です。
lines.en: I worry the collar might come off.
lines.style: protective mother voicing a safety concern

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: サイズ合わせたら、簡単にはとれへんよ。
lines.en: Fit it right and it will not slip off.
lines.style: reassuring Kansai owner solving her worry

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 体の垢もちゃんと洗ってあげなきゃ。
lines.en: I will have to wash the grime off its body too.
lines.style: caring mother picturing the daily routine
